title.description: The pull request title, imperative, under 70 characters. Empty on no_fix.

why.description: 1-3 plain sentences: what the change does and why it fixes the causes.

causes_addressed.description: The keys from dossier/causes.md that the change fixes.

note.description: Why it did not run, or what failed.

no_fix_reason.description: One plain sentence on why there is no fix. Null on fixed.
